name: hattn_ks_entry-m5-COMMIT
purpose: el1011-hbm-attn-phys two-level halves: v12 half routes failed on one clock root over 1.78 mm (balanced spine 2.55 ns: IO hold -1.8/-2.4 ns, fwd clock kq[1] -2.8 ns; spine child-insertion double-counts the quad ETM: bank->quad rst_n -771 ps) and on soft glue in the macro-packed SE corner (hi guard/merge preroute -8.35 ns). Halves become closed banks + quads + three glue leaf tiles placed by the B2 cluster; this is one of them.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_attn_ks_entry u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_attn_die_half_b.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_attn_die_tile_b.sv rtl/common/ot_fwd_link_stage.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hattn_ks_entry/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hattn_ks_entry/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hattn_ks_entry --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_attn_ks_entry  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
